integrity.authorship_provenance: No author, institutional or independent-certification claim is asserted.
integrity.mathematical_claim: One sharp Gaussian one-step reuse-versus-split risk identity and its fixed-radius/angular and SNR consequences; see RESULT.md.
integrity.proof_basis: Gaussian orthogonal rotation, sign-product selection, Gaussian truncated first moment and strict logarithmic concavity.
integrity.verification: Stand-alone Python standard-library conditional Gaussian quadrature and deterministic diagnostics in verify.py; analytic proof is primary.

scientific_limitations: Exact for the two-row identity system, equal-variance independent Gaussian residual noise and one unrelaxed update only.
The comparison is per update, not at equal oracle-query cost: uniform, reuse and split consume respectively one, two and three noisy observations.
Does not prove multi-step convergence or extend to unequal/correlated noise or nonorthogonal rows.
Specialized prior work could contain an equivalent one-step Gaussian risk statement; publication priority is not certified.
title: Exact Gaussian selection-reuse penalty and sharp one-step risk phase diagram for two-row Kaczmarz
